title: kate-ui: hide the lines of a collapsed fold
summary: The editor paints only the lines that layout::rows_to_lines returns, so a collapsed fold shows its header line and hides the lines inside. The header line ends with an ellipsis marker. cmd-alt-[ and a click on the marker toggle the fold. Visual row arithmetic for the caret uses the same list.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

definitions.definition:
/// Collapsed spans as (header line, end line) pairs for `rows_to_lines`.
fn collapsed_spans(ws: &Workspace, doc: DocumentId, view: ViewId) -> Vec<(u32, u32)>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary:
collapsed_spans maps each range in view.collapsed to the line of range.start() and the line of range.end() minus one when end sits at a line start. paint_viewport and the catch-up use rows_to_lines(first_line, rows, line_count, &spans) for the lines it paints; the row index gives the y position. The header line gets a ⋯ marker after its text in the comment color. reveal_caret and the scroll use the same list so a caret inside a hidden line first opens the fold.
